suggested_issue_title: Aspose.3D FOSS for TypeScript: npm run lint fails because the repository has no ESLint configuration
suggested_issue_body:
## Summary

`npm run lint` fails immediately because the repository contains no ESLint configuration file. `package.json` defines the `lint` script and lists `eslint` and the `@typescript-eslint` packages as devDependencies, but there is no `.eslintrc.*`, no `eslint.config.*` and no `eslintConfig` entry.

## Environment

- Revision `66cb26df3b031f0bf6976d4e88dc89721983afa4` (default branch `master`)
- Node.js v22.23.3 and npm 10.9.9 (Docker image `node:22-slim`, Linux); the same results on Windows with Node.js v22.11.0
- `npm install` and `npm run build` complete without errors; verified on 2026-10-16

## Steps to reproduce

```sh
npm install
npm run lint
```

## Expected

ESLint runs over `src/**/*.ts` and reports findings or none.

## Actual result

```
> @aspose/3d@24.12.0 lint
> eslint 'src/**/*.ts'

Oops! Something went wrong! :(

ESLint: 8.57.1

ESLint couldn't find a configuration file. To set up a configuration file for this project, please run:

    npm init @eslint/config
```

## Where in the repository

- `package.json:10` (`"lint": "eslint 'src/**/*.ts'"`) and the `eslint`, `@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin` and `@typescript-eslint/parser` devDependencies
- The root of the repository holds `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `jest.config.js`, `package.json`, `src`, `tests` and `tsconfig.json`; no ESLint configuration
